scope: Actual complete Unix socket/network namespace graph; worker creation, socketpair, membership and short controls; original-resource owner ancillary fallback.
method: Four processes each perform 1,000 checked operations, four Trames vCPUs. Three unprofiled counterbalanced before/after repetitions after compilation, with local Linux CI stopped. Longest-child loop and process-wall medians; separate profiles include process startup/teardown. Fresh socket creation, dup, shared flags, options and close are inside create loop. Pair additionally includes socketpair, bytes, shutdown and EOF. Rights loop retains its original sockets/pipe outside the timer. Native macOS uses native Unix APIs; native ARM64 Linux runs the identical static musl ELF on the existing six-vCPU local CI machine. Different host kernels/API semantics are contextual references, not a Firefox/whole-app/physical-iPad speedup claim. Rights-loop difference is small and not claimed as a significant improvement.

apple_vfs.method: Full shared-graph suite plus final pinned five-case resource/creation regression. Unchanged passing tests reused after typed socket admission factoring.

apple_kernel.method: Full final production suite; rerun only the directory/PTY test-wait adjustments.

linux_kernel.method: Reuse 266 passing final production full-suite cases; failed directory test corrected to park on its existing futex, then that case and adjusted PTY wait pass. Strict kernel check passes separately.

validation.unchanged_acceptance: Reuse unchanged guest artifacts and unrelated CPU/memory/graphics acceptance. Test-only wait and documentation changes do not trigger repeat full acceptance.

production_issue.observed: Initial production FFI systemd startup hit the old joined-shared-byte unreachable when a raw socket read needed owner ancillary handling.
production_issue.fix: Retained Unix byte checkpoint, original OFD owner handling and resource wait; read/readv and close/reuse regressions plus final 13 FFI checks pass.

test_wait_correction.observed: Old signalfd and directory tests could finish one task and spin away the shared instruction allowance before the peer completed. The same terminal wait pattern existed in the PTY control test.
test_wait_correction.fix: Finished tasks park with original futex waits; affected cases only are rerun. No production wait policy, timeout or instruction allowance is changed.

implementation.ownership: Arc actual control graph and full SOFDs; derived Send/Sync, no unsafe Rc export.
implementation.connection: One canonical once-published binding; connected bytes do not lock connection controls. Original readiness retained across connect.
implementation.ancillary: Portable rights exclude Unix-bearing/owner graphs. Original owner cycle checks/journal remain; closed destinations reap on existing joined boundary.
implementation.synchronization: Object-local structural/queue/namespace locks and necessary publication atomics; no global socket/VFS lock, service thread, bus or ordinary guest memory fence.
